messages.author: 267c7c6c510dc8a2
messages.subject: Re: Standardized regression coefficients aka β
parts:
You can export residuals and predictions using the export sub dialog in the regression dialog. You can export the output of the regression using the file -> save. The actual model object can be saved by exporting in the export sub dialog and saving your workspace in workspace -> save as.


Ian

Hello!
How do you export ·export the linear model with Deducer."

To get the beta coefficients I export the linear model with Deducer. Then, I type "lm.beta(model)" using the added package lm.beta. Or alternatively, the package Betas can be used.

messages.author: 267c7c6c510dc8a2
messages.subject: Re: Issue with Linear Models no longer working
parts:
Hi Bruce,

You are modeling FA as a factor. Since “46.3” doesn’t exist in your dataset except for the row with a missing outcome, predict won’t work. Predict can only do predictions on factor levels it has seen before. I’d think about treating FA as numeric in your model.


Best,
Ian

I will never again simply "UPDATE" packages and always do fresh install.
Bruce
